_comment: picket-edge-update's normal dependencies (build-and-test.md §4, "Updater dependencies"): JSON, minisign verification and tar.gz unpacking only, so no DNS, network, TLS or async code reaches the root installer. scripts/check-updater-deps.sh fails on any crate in `cargo tree -p picket-edge-update -e normal` not listed here. Keep one "crate": "why" entry per line; versions come from Cargo.lock.

crates.minisign-verify: minisign verification (no dependencies of its own)
crates.tar: tar unpacking (default features off: no xattr)
crates.libc: tar and filetime (bindings only; the updater itself uses std)
